newsitem.title: UK: London tea auction sees good demand.
newsitem.headline: London tea auction sees good demand.

text.p: Landed offerings met strong demand and there was good inquiry for offshore teas at the latest auction by the Tea Brokers' Association of London.

New season Assams sold well with prices following quality up to 213 pence which was the highest price realised. East Africans met good competitition at fully firm rates particularly Dusts which often appreciated.
Altogether 5,308 packages were offered including 800 offshore.
